title: watch on a stopped run says 'holding for a person' then 'nothing is held'
description:
For a stopped run the model's attention is a dead-run resume, so the frame shows 'needs you: … ticfac run hn6 --cloud' and the alert prints '! … is holding for a person … move it on: ticfac run hn6 --cloud'. The ending then prints 'ended CANCELLED … nothing is held for a person' without the resume command, and exits 7. One command run gives two opposite answers. The cancelled ending should name the resume command, the same one the frame names.
evidence: internal/cli/watch.go:1279-1287 (watchEndHolding cancelled branch) vs :1226 (watchAttentionAlertText); live: ticfac watch epic-hn6 in a pty, exit 7

ticfac run epic-hn6 created this tick by absorbing the finding a56238cd0c1175da211f1e63dbe169fcc943bdb11edb60a324863e6f727c9cbe (reported by run-epic-hn6/tick-435/attempt-22): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A2. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-hn6/absorptions/a56238cd0c1175da211f1e63dbe169fcc943bdb11edb60a324863e6f727c9cbe.json on the run branch.
